Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add GGUF metadata extraction support \(PR #399\)

This implements the changes from https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF/pull/399
to add support for loading model configuration directly from GGUF file metadata.

Changes:
- Added get_gguf_metadata\(\) function to extract metadata fields from GGUF files
- Modified gguf_sd_loader\(\) to return \(state_dict, metadata\) tuple
- Updated gguf_sd_loader\(\) with return_arch=True to return \(state_dict, arch, metadata\)
- Fixed gguf_clip_loader\(\) to handle new return signature
- Fixed gguf_mmproj_loader\(\) to handle new return signature
- Updated load_unet\(\) in nodes.py to pass metadata to load_diffusion_model_state_dict\(\)

This enables proper loading of newer models like LTX2 that store configuration
in the GGUF file headers rather than as separate files.

Co-Authored-By: Vantage with AI <anshoosr@gmail.com>
Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix compatibility with ComfyUI-GGUF metadata changes

Updated GGUFLoader node to handle the new return signature from
ComfyUI-GGUF''s gguf_sd_loader\(\) function, which now returns
\(state_dict, metadata\) instead of just state_dict.

This is required for compatibility with ComfyUI-GGUF PR #399 which
adds metadata extraction support for models like LTX2.

Changes:
- Updated model loading to unpack metadata from gguf_sd_loader\(\)
- Updated extra model loading to unpack metadata
- Merged metadata from extra models into main model metadata
- Pass metadata to load_diffusion_model_state_dict\(\)

Fixes AttributeError: ''dict'' object has no attribute ''startswith''

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
